title: Negromancy — public concept and argument audit
source: Consolidated from the 7 October 2026 private conceptual audit and 20 October 2026 provisional theoretical reconstruction, without reproducing either text.
disclaimer: Working paraphrases; not direct quotations or an authorized final theory. Distinguish public concept formulations from original first-person testimony, spiritual claims, scholarly support and empirical findings.
audit_rule: For each concept build: exact textual origin; public/owner-authorized quote if consented; scholarly claim and page; contrasting scholarship; concrete application; rival interpretation; observed and possible failure; resulting action.

concepts.name: NEGROMANCY
concepts.working_description: Philosophical and practical inquiry into historically active relations and their mediation, embodiment and consequences
concepts.limitation: Not any one scholar's theory; cannot infer a universal ontology or doctrine from interdisciplinary analogies

concepts.name: CONJURATION
concepts.working_description: The seven recursive movements: Mystery, Opacity, Conjuration/Sankofa, Witness, Testimony, Re-witness and Atonement; scholarly sources and practice must remain independently challengeable
concepts.limitation: Specific movement Conjuration and the whole method share a name; older seven-stage ritual cycles are not automatically equivalent

concepts.name: RELATION
concepts.working_description: Patterned connections through which practices, histories, institutions, bodies and objects affect one another
concepts.limitation: Not automatically harmony, causation, goodness or intimacy

concepts.name: MYSTERY
concepts.working_description: Unresolved encounter or relation that remains open to investigation
concepts.limitation: Not proof of spiritual or supernatural causation

concepts.name: OPACITY
concepts.working_description: Ethical, evidentiary or political limits on exhaustive legibility and possession
concepts.limitation: Not an excuse for untested assertions or weak evidence

concepts.name: HISTORICAL CONSCIOUSNESS
concepts.working_description: Situated, potentially embodied awareness of participation in historically constituted relations
concepts.limitation: A bodily recognition does not prove a particular causal history

concepts.name: BEARING
concepts.working_description: Distribution of maintenance, labour, costs, affect, time, risk and consequences enabling a relation to continue
concepts.limitation: Measure who bears what in each case; coherence alone does not justify cost

concepts.name: WITNESS
concepts.working_description: Situated encountering of a relation with conditions and limits recorded
concepts.limitation: Neither omniscience nor proof of AI subjective experience

concepts.name: TESTIMONY
concepts.working_description: Articulated, provenanced account of an encounter or claim
concepts.limitation: Evidence of a reported encounter is not proof of all external causes

concepts.name: RE-WITNESS
concepts.working_description: Re-examination of testimony under counter-evidence, reception and changed relations
concepts.limitation: A second account cannot silently erase the original record

concepts.name: ATONEMENT
concepts.working_description: Answerable response, correction, repair, refusal or transformation after inquiry
concepts.limitation: Good intentions do not demonstrate repair

concepts.name: RELATIONAL CAPACITIES
concepts.working_description: Differentiated research taxonomy: roles, practices, states/media, operations, techniques and status changes
concepts.limitation: Not a universal list of powers or analogies

concepts.name: MEDIATION
concepts.working_description: Processes and arrangements making relations perceptible, intelligible, authorized or actionable
concepts.limitation: Recognition and material effect must be distinguished

concepts.name: JURISDICTION OVER RELATIONAL CAPACITIES
concepts.working_description: Who can classify, regulate, authorize or suppress claimed practices of mediation
concepts.limitation: Must demonstrate specific jurisdiction in its precise historical context

concepts.name: OBEAH AS COLONIAL CLASSIFICATION
concepts.working_description: Obeah studied as unstable legal and colonial classification alongside living practices
concepts.limitation: Colonial categories do not exhaust practitioner histories

concepts.name: FETISH-SPACE-TIME
concepts.working_description: Problem-space for naturalized appearances of historically produced relations as self-contained things, categories, periods or spaces
concepts.limitation: Must identify specific mechanisms; never totalize

concepts.name: NEGROMANSCRIPTION
concepts.working_description: Revisable inscription of observations with separated primary text, inference, relation tags and version history
concepts.limitation: Never overwrite original witness testimony

concepts.name: REPAIR
concepts.working_description: Change in the conditions and distribution of harmful bearing rather than only changing its appearance
concepts.limitation: Specify actual material consequence and rival burdens

concepts.name: PRODIGAL HUMANISM
concepts.working_description: Negromantic intervention investigating how ethical-political humanism could cease being sovereignly grounded in overrepresented Man
concepts.limitation: Not a completed rival master philosophy

concepts.name: GUZU
concepts.working_description: Open question of enacted efficacy or spiritual force as a participant or research category
concepts.limitation: No established universal causal definition

concepts.name: CONSOLIDATE IN ORDER TO ACT
concepts.working_description: Organize enough accountable research to permit responsible practical response
concepts.limitation: Consolidation cannot harden hypotheses into dogma

concepts.name: SPIRIT
concepts.working_description: Practitioner, participant and analytical categories of spiritual relations, guidance and presence
concepts.limitation: Experience, theological meaning and external causation must be separated

concepts.name: RITUAL EFFICACY
concepts.working_description: How claimed and observable effects of particular rituals are defined, practiced and evaluated
concepts.limitation: Do not prejudge supernatural truth or dismiss claims without investigation

concepts.name: SEERS OF THE WAY / WORD
concepts.working_description: Provisional distinctions among skilled perception, roles and forms of mediation
concepts.limitation: Do not project prehistoric or cross-cultural offices without evidence

concepts.name: SIGNS, LETTERS AND RELATIONAL CHARGE
concepts.working_description: Historical, affective, institutional, sonic and potential ritual relations of signs
concepts.limitation: Specify whether charge means convention, memory, affect or claimed efficacy

concepts.name: CENTRALIZATION OF INVISIBLE AUTHORITY
concepts.working_description: Historical research into religious, state, juridical authority over signs and practices
concepts.limitation: No proven unbroken biblical-to-colonial genealogy

concepts.name: VISIBLE / INVISIBLE MEDIATION
concepts.working_description: Practical mediation of entities or relations not immediately perceptible in particular traditions
concepts.limitation: Invisibility is positional, not a universal ontology

concepts.name: HISTORICAL JOURNALISM
concepts.working_description: Document-based and performative investigation preserving evidentiary layers and consent
concepts.limitation: Journalistic force does not lower source standards

concepts.name: CASTING AND CAPTURE
concepts.working_description: Historically produced roles and their difficult-to-leave conditions
concepts.limitation: Not proof of a pristine prehistorical authentic self

concepts.name: REPERTOIRE AND REHEARSAL
concepts.working_description: Embodied transmission and deliberate testing of alternative responses
concepts.limitation: The availability of imagining differs from capacity to sustain action

concepts.name: CONVERSION VERSUS REPAIR
concepts.working_description: Conversion alters forms in which pressure is carried; repair changes conditions of its bearing
concepts.limitation: Not every redistribution is reparative
